serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.veryHappy
#bot.ArmBoth.UpHi
Bot: Ta-dah!
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
Bot: We finally arrived here! Crazy Mouse Amusement Park! Aren’t you excited?!
#bot.Expression.veryAngry
You: I sure am, but isn’t this place more for children?
Bot: Of course not!
Bot: Crazy Mouse Amusement Park is for people of all ages! It says on their website!
You: Isn’t that just a sales pitch?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: If this place is for children then why the biggest rollercoaster is for people taller than 150cm? That’s approximately 59 inches.
You: 59 Inches is a completely normal height for a child.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.VeryShock
Bot: Please start enjoying things.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.veryHappy
You: I will! I will!
For a second I felt that my life was in danger…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: Alright, I will do my best to enjoy our time here.
Bot: On what ride do you want to get on first?
You: Let’s do some fun games first. I need to get some exercise after that trip.
Bot: Sure, what do you have in mind?
You: Let’s do a set of two competitions and see who is victorious at the end.
Bot: Ok!
You: Do they have arcade basketball? It was one of my favorite games back in the day. 
Bot: They do! Wanna start with that one?
You: Sure, but just so you know. I’m pretty good at it.
